_comment: CARIBOU v1.0 LONG sleeve — cross-asset trend fund (managed futures / CTA). Scans a maximally diversified universe across EVERY asset class on Hyperliquid (crypto, xyz stocks, indices, metals, energy) and opens LONGS on assets in a confirmed UPTREND (4h structure bullish is the hard gate; daily aligns; 24h momentum + RSI blow-off guard refine). Time-series trend (each asset vs its own history), NOT cross-sectional. Positions are sized to EQUAL RISK via volatility parity (margin scales inversely with the asset's ATR%, normalized to referenceVolPct, clamped) and capped per asset CLASS so the book can never collapse into one class. Pairs with the SHORT sleeve (caribou-short-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet — the two sleeves are independent so the fund CAN hold the same asset long in one and short in the other. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, the asymmetric trend DSL (cut losers fast, let winners run, time-cuts off) via runtime-long.yaml. Producer launched with CARIBOU_LEG=long.
_sizing_note: VOLATILITY PARITY: margin = account_value * baseRiskPct * (referenceVolPct / asset_ATR%), clamped to [minMarginPct, maxMarginPct] of equity. A calm index (~1.5% daily ATR) gets ~2x base margin; a wild memecoin (~6%) gets ~0.5x — each position contributes ~equal risk. Leverage is baseLeverage, bumped to maxLeverage on an apexScore trend, then clamped to the asset's HL venue max. Nothing here is a hardcoded $ amount.
_class_cap_note: classMarginCapPct caps total deployed margin in any ONE asset class (crypto/equity/index/metal/energy) at 40% of equity, so the book stays diversified across classes — the entire CTA edge. maxSlots 8 = a diversified book.
_persona: Cross-asset trend-follower (managed futures) — LONG sleeve. Follows confirmed uptrends across all of Hyperliquid, vol-parity sized, class-capped, let-winners-run DSL. One of two sleeves of the Caribou cross-asset trend fund; pairs with the short sleeve on a separate wallet.
